results.question: How much memory does the NovaBook 14 have?
results.actual_answer: The NovaBook 14 has 16 GB of memory.

results.question: Can I combine two gift cards with my credit card to pay for an order?
results.actual_answer: Yes, you can combine up to two gift cards with one credit card to pay for an order.

results.question: How much does the OrbitPlus membership cost?
results.actual_answer: The OrbitPlus membership costs USD 49 annually.

results.question: How many business days does standard domestic shipping take?
results.actual_answer: Standard domestic shipping normally takes three to five business days after dispatch.

results.question: Can I return opened ear tips?
results.actual_answer: Opened ear tips are non-returnable unless defective, as they are classified as hygiene accessories.

results.question: How long is the warranty for the HomeHub Mini and when does coverage begin?
results.actual_answer: The warranty for the HomeHub Mini is 24 months, and coverage begins on confirmed delivery for shipped orders and on collection for store-pickup orders.

results.question: What should I do if my device starts smoking?
results.actual_answer: If your device starts smoking, you should power it down when safe and disconnect it from charging. Do not open the device or bypass any electrical safety features. It is advisable to escalate the issue to support.

results.question: Will OrbitTech staff ever ask for my one-time authentication code?
results.actual_answer: No, OrbitTech staff will never ask for your one-time authentication code.

results.question: How long does a supervisor take to review a formal service complaint?
results.actual_answer: A supervisor reviews a formal service complaint within five business days.

results.question: Is there a restocking fee if I return an opened device after 10 days?
results.actual_answer: Yes, there is a restocking fee if you return an opened device after 10 days. For orders placed on or after September 1, 2026, an opened device may be returned within 14 calendar days and is subject to a 10% restocking fee.

results.question: Can a carrier leave my new NovaBook 14 unattended at my door since it costs $1200?
results.actual_answer: No, a carrier cannot leave your new NovaBook 14 unattended at your door since it costs $1200. Orders containing devices valued above USD 1,000 require an adult signature, and OrbitTech does not authorize carriers to leave such packages unattended.

results.question: If I cancel my OrbitPlus membership within 7 days, do I get a refund?
results.actual_answer: If you cancel your OrbitPlus membership within 14 calendar days, you will receive a full refund only if you have not used any member discounts, free shipping, or priority service. If any of those benefits have been used, the membership remains active until its annual expiry and is not refunded.

results.question: If my PulsePhone X stops working because I opened its battery, will the warranty cover it?
results.actual_answer: No, the warranty will not cover the PulsePhone X if it stops working because you opened its battery. The warranty specifically states that customers must not open a sealed battery or bypass electrical safety features.

results.question: I paid partially with a gift card and partially with my credit card. If I return the device, can I get all my money back in cash?
results.actual_answer: If you return the device, you cannot get the portion paid with a gift card back in cash. That amount will be returned to a replacement gift card. The portion paid with your credit card will be refunded to that card.

results.question: If my account is compromised and someone places an unauthorized order that has already been dispatched, can I still cancel it?
results.actual_answer: If your account is compromised and an unauthorized order has already been dispatched, cancellation or interception is not guaranteed. You should contact Account Security to coordinate with the Payments and Delivery teams, but the ability to cancel depends on the order's status.

results.question: Do I have to wait for routine support if there is an active account compromise?
results.actual_answer: No, you do not have to wait for routine support if there is an active account compromise. Such issues can be escalated immediately without waiting.

results.question: Can I use OrbitPlus to get a discount on a screen protector, and then return it after I open it?
results.actual_answer: You can use OrbitPlus to get a discount on a screen protector, but you cannot return it after opening. Opened screen protectors are non-returnable unless defective.

results.question: When will the OrbitTech microwave I ordered arrive?
results.actual_answer: The delivery of your OrbitTech microwave will depend on the shipping method you selected. If you chose standard domestic shipping, it should arrive in three to five business days after dispatch. If you opted for express shipping, it will arrive in one to two business days after dispatch. Please note that these are estimates and not guarantees, and additional time may be required for orders to remote areas.
